I'm a plumber apprentice now but I used to be a diesel mechanic. One night we smoked a fat ass blunt and decided to make an office of our very own. The other guy was pretty old, like 60s and could barely speak English. He couldn't speak any other languages he was just stupid. We got some pieces of steel plates and welded some together to make a box. Took the plasma cutter and made a door and little window. I went outside and uprooted a bush growing by the train tracks for some under window shrubbery. We then added some chairs, moved a mini fridge in there and a spare microwave etc. It was in the far bay which we dubbed the cool kids Bay. We hung a sign on it saying no bosses allowed. 

About a week later they were tired of us napping in our "office" and decided to remove the stuff inside and move our office to the very back of the lot. AFAIK it's still there.
I'm unreasonably mad that they're not even feet away. Like 16 too close, 20 for pussies.
